title: The Reincarnated Elf Left on a Journey to Master His Magic Anime's New Video Reveals More Cast/Staff, Theme Songs, December 30 Streaming Debut
content:
ASMIK Ace revealed on Thursday the main promotional video, key visual, additional cast and staff members, theme songs, and the December 30 advance streaming premiere for The Reincarnated Elf Left on a Journey to Master His Magic and With His Extra Lifespan Became a Living Legend , the television anime of Monshō Sakakibara 's Majutsu o Kiwamete Tabi ni Deta Tensei Elf, Moteamashita Jumyō de Ikeru Densetsu to Naru ( Tensei Elf for short) light novel series. The video announces and previews the opening theme song "Breath" by ao, and the ending theme song "Ja Mata, Raise de mo" (See You Later, in the Afterlife) by moon drop.

The newly announced cast members are:

Haruka Terui as Rahab, the legendary elf

Nobuyuki Hiyama as Grillet, the lord of a neighboring territory

Hiro Shimono as Gallius, Grillet's son

Megumi Ogata as Sylpha, Grillet's wife

Additional staff members include:

• Assistant Director: Yusei Miura

• Character Design: Kaori Yoshikawa

• Chief Animation Director: Kaori Yoshikawa

• Art Director: Ayumi Inoue

• CG Director: Hiroki Kawamoto

• Color Design: Haruka Yanatori

• Sound Director: Yuki Inaba

• Editing: Kanami Yogo

• Music: Kenichi Takano, Jun Ichikawa

The anime will exclusively stream on the ABEMA and d Anime Store streaming services in Japan starting on December 30, a week ahead of its television broadcast on January 6. The anime will air on the Tokyo MX , BS Fuji , Hokkaido Broadcasting, CBC TV , RCC Chugoku, i-TELEVISION , and RKB Mainichi channels in Japan.

ASMIK Ace describes the story:

Reincarnated as an elf— After his ordinary life comes to an abrupt end in a sudden accident, he is reincarnated as an elf with a lifespan of 1,000 years. Determined to live a life without regrets and leave behind proof of his existence, he sets out on a journey—where he reunites with a young girl whose life he once saved. An isekai fantasy depicting the journey of a reincarnated elf, marked by encounters and farewells.

The anime stars Daiki Yamashita as Liese and Hana Hishikawa as Minori.

Yuki Inaba ( KamiKatsu: Working for God in a Godless World ; Parasyte -the maxim- , Shōnen Ashibe GO! GO! Goma-chan episode director) is directing the anime at Studio Palette , and is also in charge of series scripts.

Sakakibara launched the story on the Kakuyomu website in 2021. Starts Publishing released one volume of the novel with illustrations by Hatori Kyoka in 2022.

The manga adaptation by kanco launched on Starts Publishing 's Novema website in May 2023, under the company's isekai label Glast COMICS. The manga is also serialized on Starts Publishing 's new manga website Manga Zegra. The manga's first compiled book volume shipped in March 2024, and the seventh volume shipped on October 23.
author: ANN

title: Monthly CoroCoro Comic Magazine to Release Digital Version 1 Week After Print Version
content:
The official X/Twitter account for Shogakukan 's Monthly CoroCoro Comic magazine announced on November 13 that the magazine's digital version will begin releasing about one week after the physical magazine's release (as opposed to the current simultaneous releases) beginning with the current December issue that released on November 13.

The magazine launched its companion manga website Weekly CoroCoro Comic in March 2022.

Monthly CoroCoro Comic publishes serialized manga aimed at children, including manga based on toy properties and games.

Some of the manga serialized in the magazine include various Pokémon , Beyblade , Duel Masters , Splatoon , Kirby , Zoids , and Inazuma Eleven manga, as well as Fate Rewinder: All Great Feats Require Time , Black Channel , and 100% Pascal-sensei , among others.

title: Not-Sew-Wicked Stepmom Webtoon Gets TV Anime Adaptation
content:
Piccoma , Kakao's Japanese digital comics platform, announced on Thursday a television anime adaptation of the webtoon/web novel Not-Sew-Wicked Stepmom , which has accumulated more than 100 million views across Kakao's and Tapas ' platforms.

The series has recorded approximately 11.7 million views on Tapas , 72.66 million on Kakao Page , and 16.7 million on Kakao Webtoon , bringing its combined total to approximately 101.06 million views.

The story of the webtoon reads:

Fairytale stepmothers are notoriously wicked. But after a children's clothing designer is reborn as young Princess Blanche's stepmom, she's determined to break the mold and shower her daughter with love. Now she just has to convince the girl's cold-hearted father to do the same. In her quest to make a happier home for Blanche, Abigail begins to uncover secrets and schemes within the palace. Will devious forces tear the Freidkins apart, or can Abigail stitch them back into a family?

The announcement did not disclose further details about the anime, including its production staff, cast, or release date.

Iru is the author of the original web novel series, and Mo9Rang is the webtoon artist. The webtoon series ended in Korean on November 3, but the series will have side stories in the future.

Mo9Rang posted a comment image about the adaptation announcement in Korean, Japanese, and English on Thursday.

Fans can read the webtoon on Tapas ( Tapas has not updated the series since it announced its March 2027 shutdown on October 1). Ize Press is releasing the webtoon in print and released the 10th volume on October 26.

title: The Detective Is Already Dead Game Launches in 2027
content:
Taito announced that its game based on Nigojū and Umibōzu 's The Detective Is Already Dead ( Tantei wa Mō, Shindeiru. ) light novel series will launch in 2027. Taito is developing the game for Switch.

Yen Press is publishing the original novels in English and describes the story:

When the story begins without its hero Kimihiko Kimizuka has always been a magnet for trouble and intrigue. For as long as he can remember, he's been stumbling across murder scenes or receiving mysterious attache cases to transport. When he met Siesta, a brilliant detective fighting a secret war against an organization of pseudohumans, he couldn't resist the call to become her assistant and join her on an epic journey across the world. Until a year ago, that is. Now he's returned to a life that is normal and tepid by comparison, knowing the adventure must be over. After all, The Detective Is Already Dead .

Kadokawa published the first volume in the light novel series with illustrations by Umibōzu in November 2019 under Kadokawa 's MF Bunko J imprint. The novel won the 15th MF Bunko J newcomer award in 2019. Kadokawa published the 14th novel on October 23. The novel series will end with its 15th volume. Yen Press shipped the 12th novel in English on August 11.

The anime's first season premiered with a one-hour special in July 2021 and aired for 12 episodes. Funimation began streaming the anime in July 2021, and also streamed an English dub .

The second season debuted on October 7, and Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as it airs.

Hoko Hinachi and Minori Chigusa launched a new spinoff novel titled Charlotte wa Tada, Jiken o Tokitai. Tantei wa Mō, Shindeiru. Code:RED in May 2024. nigozyu is credited for the original work and as a supervisor for the novel.

Mugiko launched the manga adaptation of the main novels in Kadokawa 's Monthly Comic Alive magazine in May 2020, and ended it in October 2023. Kadokawa published the manga's sixth and final compiled book volume in October 2023.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Leviathan Film Casts Shun Oguri, Ai Hashimoto
content:
The staff for the live-action film of Shiro Kuroi 's Leviathan manga announced on Thursday two more cast members.

Shun Oguri (left in image below) plays Senri Senda, and Ai Hashimoto (right in image below) plays Yuriko Momose. Both characters are teachers trapped in the survival battle with their students.

Abrams ComicArts ' manga-focused imprint for the U.S. market Kana publishes the story in English and describes the story:

Perfect for fans of Moebius, Star Wars , and Katsuhiro Ōtomo , Shiro Kuroi 's Leviathan Volume One follows a group of students pitted against each other in a brutal battle for survival in the depths of space. The gripping sci-fi survival horror centers around the Leviathan , an enormous spaceship, abandoned in a galaxy far, far away. When looters break into the abandoned ship, they discover the diary of a middle-schooler, Kazuma, who documented the horrific fate of the ship's passengers. Along with the looters, the reader will piece together the decades-old tale of an innocent school trip to Earth with a tragic and brutal ending. Trapped in space without enough oxygen left to wait for rescue, Kazuma documents the mental collapse and treachery of his teacher and classmates as they realize that the only hope for survival is the cryopreservation unit at the heart of the ship, which can only fit one person. A bloody battle for survival ensues as friend turns against friend, teacher against student, and each survivor is forced to confront the value of their own life. As the looters read on, they reach a chilling realization—there is still one survivor somewhere inside! One of the top bestselling new manga titles in Japan, Leviathan 's incredible, brutal illustrations and tightly paced plot will leave readers at the edge of their seats, and linger in their minds long after the last page of each volume.

Shunsuke Michieda stars as Kazuma Ichinose and Natsuki Deguchi stars as Futaba Nikaido.

Previously announced cast members include Kaito Sakurai , Kairi Jō , Ryūto Sakuma , Riko, Kotone Hanase , Miku Tanaka , Yōko Shōgenji , UTA, Ikuho Akiya, Kazuto Mokudai , Shō Nishigaki , Kōki Maeda , Towa Natsume, Ui Mihara , Momoko Kobayashi, Sara Shida, Taketo Tanaka , Kiita Komagine, Hayato Kurihara, Ren Natsumi, Kyohei Shimokawa, Kento Sakurai, Haruto Yoshida, Yusuke Kawabata, Masato Yamashita , Sosuke Ogata, Raiju Kamata, Marin Nishimoto , Kokoro Aoshima, Suika Yamazaki, Kotoko Nagayama, Honoka Kiba, Mio Akiyoshi, Mayuki Fujita, Kyōmi Sawada, and Airi Takeuchi.

Michihito Fujii ( Last Samurai Standing ) and Ryōhei Shingū are directing the film, and TOHO is distributing it.

The film will open in theaters in Japan on February 11, 2027.

Kuroi debuted the manga in France via Ki-oon in January 2022, and in Japan in Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ service in August 2022. The series ended in February 2023. The manga's third compiled book volume shipped in Japan in May 2023.
author: ANN

title: Seven Seas Licenses 'I am Blue, in Pain, and Fragile,' Predator Witches Audiobooks
content:
Seven Seas announced the following audiobook licenses on Wednesday:

Title: I am Blue, in Pain, and Fragile audiobook Creators: Yoru Sumino , Fusui Narration: Julian Cihi Release Date: December 17 (Siren imprint) Summary: Two young people in their first year of university, drawn to each other's passion, establish a secret society to pursue those ideals. But as time passes, the demands of a world that isn't kind to dreamers threatens to force them apart, filling the space between them with shattered hopes and the fallout of lies. A tender, tragic tale about growing past pain and the cruelty of youth, by acclaimed author Yoru Sumino .

Title: Predator Witches audiobook Creators: Bashōzoku Bashōka , Tōzai Narration: Juniper West Release Date: December 17 (volume 1, Siren imprint) Summary: Monsters called incubi swarm the world, using humans as incubators to reproduce. The only ones standing in their way are witches—young girls granted powers by a supernatural entity known as the Old Witch.

Schoolgirl Renka Azuma transforms into the witch Silver Lotus, commanding legions of massive insects in battle against the incubi. Solitary and dispassionate, she is unprepared for what happens when she rescues a novice witch called Azure Nova, earning herself a superfan for life. Azure's worship of her hides a darker edge—and Renka's life will never be the same again.

Seven Seas also announced that it will launch an English audiobook version of Bo Mu Bing Lun's The Lucky Egg Game: Cai Dan You Xi danmei series with the first book on December 24.

title: Webtoon 'Not-Sew-Wicked Stepmom' Gets TV Anime
content:
Publishing company Kakao Piccoma announced a television anime adaptation of Ilu and Moguraeng 's Not-Sew-Wicked Stepmom webtoon on Thursday, revealing an announcement visual (pictured). The anime will premiere under the Japanese title Mamahaha dakedo Musume ga Kawaisugiru .

Iru originally wrote the isekai villainess novel on the KakaoPage website from January 2019 to May 2019, with illustrations by Dinorex. The main story concluded with 186 chapters, followed by 24 side story chapters published between August 2019 and September 2019. Crescendo published the novel in five volumes, with the final volume released in October 2020.

Iru and Moguraeng began serializing the webtoon adaptation on the KakaoPage platform in April 2021. A.Tempo Media published the 11th volume on October 1.

Tapas began publishing the webtoon digitally in English in October 2021. Yen Press licensed the series under its Ize Press imprint in February 2023. The tenth volume went on sale on October 20.

Synopsis Although Lee Lily's childhood dream to become a princess seems unattainable because of her average appearance, she finds her passion in designing children's clothes. Ultimately, her job results in her demise, as she works herself to death at the age of 30.

Lily is reincarnated in what appears to be the tale of Snow White as the story's villainess—the cruel and vain queen Abigail Freidkin. Now in Abigail's body, Lily wishes to befriend her stepdaughter Blanche, a sweet girl and her latest muse. However, it is a challenging feat, as Blanche fears her stepmother.

Furthermore, Sabrian—the current king and Abigail's spouse—may be an outstanding regent, but as a father and husband, he is uncaring and neglectful. Although she is not fond of Sabrian, Abigail will go to any length to fix the broken relationship between the Freidkins and give her stepdaughter the happiest of endings. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Sesuji's About a Pilgrimage to the Defiled Sacred Grounds Novel Gets Live-Action Film in 2027
content:
Flag Pictures announced on Thursday that Sesuji 's About a Pilgrimage to the Defiled Sacred Grounds ( Kegareta Seichijunrei ni Tsuite ) novel is inspiring a live-action film that will open in Japan in 2027. The below visual teases with the caption "A healthy you will be born."

Amazon is listing an English release of the novel under Yen Press ' Avocado House imprint on July 13, 2027. Amazon's listing describes the story:

IT DOESN'T MATTER IF IT IS TRUE, IT JUST HAS TO FEEL TRUE. Kobayashi, a freelance editor, is trying to get a publisher to bite on his latest pitch: an official guidebook for the Paranormal Punk YouTube channel, where host Ike-boy delights his viewers by charging in to the scariest haunted spots like it's nothing. The plan is to dive deeper into the stories behind a few of the places featured, but when the publisher sees the channel's middling subscriber count, they're not so sure the book will sell. If Kobayashi and Ikeda, the man behind Ike-boy, want to get this project off the ground, they're going to have to find some incredible material. And if they don't, well, they could always make something up...

Kadokawa published the novel in September 2024. Yuzuki Momoi launched the novel's manga adaptation in Kadokawa 's Monthly Comic Flapper magazine in March 2025. The manga's third compiled book volume will ship on Friday.

Sesuji serialized the About a Place in the Kinki Region story on the Kakuyomu website in January 2023. Kadokawa compiled and published the stories in a print novel in August 2023. Yen Press licensed and released the novel in English on January 20. The novel also inspired a live-action film adaptation, which opened in Japan in August 2025.
author: ANN

title: Blood Addict Manga Ends
content:
The December issue of Square Enix 's G Fantasy magazine announced on Wednesday that Umiharu 's Blood Addict ( Bloodict ) manga will end in the next issue on December 18.

Manga UP! Global publishes the series in English, and describes the story:

After being ravaged by war, Tougoku is now consumed by the endemic threat of UDL, a powerful and heavily addicting drug. Ibuki, a survivor living in the dregs of Tougoku's society, sells UDL in order to fund the search for his lost mother. But then, he meets a mysterious girl named Milfie, who soon turns his search efforts upside down.

Umiharu launched the series in Square Enix 's G Fantasy magazine in April 2025. Square Enix shipped the second compiled book volume on July 27.

title: K Manga Adds Godmother Manga
content:
Kodansha 's K MANGA platform announced on Tuesday that it has added Rin Shimokawa 's Godmother manga as a simulpub title.

The platform describes the story:

"Who should these children call 'Grandma' after I pass away?" Kinryu, a Chinese college student, was suddenly told to move to Japan. The plan was to move in with her great-grandma in Yokohama, but when she arrived, she was greeted by a strange child instead. This alone was unsettling enough, but little did she know that there were many more terrors awaiting her in the den of evil that is Yokohama's Chinatown. A hauntingly beautiful horror story, crafted by a new talent who has taken the world by storm, begins.

Nishio launched the original one-shot as part of Kodansha 's special Young Magazine US English issue in August 2025. The title launched as a series in Kodansha 's Monthly Young Magazine on Wednesday.

The top five winners are guaranteed serialization on Kodansha 's K MANGA app. The winners will also be serialized in Japan in Monthly Young Magazine and/or YanMaga Web , serializing at the same time on K MANGA .

Other winning titles include Still You , To Dusk and Twilight , Boys Run the Riot -In Transition- , Protocol Ryugu , and The Last Terran . To Dusk and Twilight , Protocol Ryugu , and The Last Terran are all currently in serialization . The Last Terran was the most recent to start, launching in Monthly Young Magazine on August 20.

One of the winning manga, Daisuke Itabashi 's The Journey of a Dark Elf with Fading Powers , began serialization in Japan in the January 2026 issue of Kodansha 's Monthly Young Magazine in December 2025. Ray Kindō 's The Knight of Blasphemy ( Tokushin no Chevalier ) manga launched in the August issue on July 16. Seven Seas Entertainment licensed The Journey of a Dark Elf with Fading Powers , and will begin releasing it in print in March 2027.
